title: Diamond League's Best Athlete Quotes of 2025
excerpt: The Wanda Diamond League's best quotes of 2025, from Frederik Ruppert, Cordell Tinch and Emmanuel Wanyonyi, and what they say to everyday runners.
body:
The Wanda Diamond League ended its 2025 season review on December 28 with a collection of the year's best athlete quotes. Three of them stand out for everyday runners.

Germany's Frederik Ruppert, after winning his Diamond League Final in Zurich: "Running here in Zurich – for me this is better than the Olympic Games because the crowd pushed me so much."

Cordell Tinch, also in Zurich: "To compete with the best in the world, you have to consider yourself one of them."

Emmanuel Wanyonyi, in Lausanne, on David Rudisha: "Rudisha told me it's my time to shine."

Each one applies well beyond the Diamond League: the boost a crowd or training group can give you, the belief you need before a hard session, and the value of encouragement from someone you respect. Read the full collection and pick the line that fits where you are in your training now.

Source: Wanda Diamond League
keyTakeaway: Pick one line that fits where you are in your training and use it on your next hard day.
